questions.stem_text: The judicial branch of the United States government has the power to ________ the law.

Which of the following purposes does the 'internal point of view' play in Hart's concept
of law?

options.A: It distinguishes social rules from mere group habits.
options.C: It illustrates the authority of the legislature.
options.D: It stresses the relationship between law and justice.

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: A - It distinguishes social rules from mere group habits.

questions.stem_text: What is the fundamental premise of monist theory?

options.A: Monism posits that international law is superior to domestic laws
options.B: Monism posits that international and domestic law are part of the same legal order
options.C: Monism posits that domestic laws are superior to international law
options.D: Monism posits that domestic and international law never clash

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: B - Monism posits that international and domestic law are part of the same legal order

questions.stem_text:
Critical Legal Studies (CLS) is often compared to (or with) American realism. Which of the
following statements is inaccurate?

options.A: Both are concerned with the 'law in action.'
options.D: Both attempt to demystify the law.

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: C - Both adopt a liberal ideology.
